title: handoff/v1
description: Session-memory handoff written by a predecessor agent session for its successor. Canonical form is this JSON; the rendered .md beside it is for humans and is never read by the ack guard. Nullable fields use oneOf with an explicit null branch, never a union type list, because the repository's schema_check subset refuses union types.

origin_host.description: Optional. Host that holds the authoritative copy of this file, stamped at create time. When a handoff is carried to another host (scp; the workstation and devbox-vm share no filesystem mount) the single-active-successor guard would otherwise be two files and two independent claims, so `ack` on any other host takes the atomic ack on the origin's copy over ssh first and updates the local copy only if that succeeded. Absent on handoffs created before the two-host guard existed, which ack then treats as local-only.

origin_path.description: Optional. Absolute path of this file on origin_host. Meaningless without origin_host; ack requires both before it will go remote.

digest_version.description: Which definition of diff_sha256 every repo in this handoff was recorded under. Absent means 1. 1 = sha256 over `git diff HEAD` bytes then `git status --porcelain` bytes. 2 = that, then one `NUL <path> NUL <sha256 of contents>` record per untracked non-ignored file (`git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`), sorted by path bytes, contents hashed as bytes so binaries are covered. v1 is blind to content changes in untracked files, which is why v2 exists; validate recomputes the definition the file declares, so v1 handoffs keep validating.

diff_sha256.description: The working-tree digest, under the definition named by state.digest_version (see that field).

running.description: Long-lived processes, background jobs or watchers the successor inherits or must not restart.

sprintctl_bundle_ref.description: Reference to a sprintctl handoff bundle written beside this file; never the bundle itself.

next_action.description: Exact text of the one action the successor executes first.

harness.description: Optional. Which harness the successor runs on ('claude-code', 'codex'). Stamped by the launcher after the ack, because ack writes this object wholesale and only a claimed handoff has a harness worth recording. Absent on handoffs acked before the Codex path existed.
